title: "Menu" opens a full-screen sheet
summary: On phones the header shows the wordmark and a "Menu" button; it opens a full-height Czech-blue sheet with the same top row (wordmark, "Zavřít" in the Menu button's place) and four large links: Dnešní hra (underlined when active), Archiv, Obsazení, Pravidla. Desktop keeps its inline links. Shots: home and archive headers, then the open sheet.
tradeoffs: Every destination is one extra tap away and "Archiv" no longer sits in the phone header; it adds a dialog, but no fixed UI covering content.
